meta.title: Sign-in and security | Puntr
meta.description: Confirm your email and turn on two-factor sign-in.

title: Sign-in and security
subtitle: Keep your account and your record safe.

prompt.confirm: Confirm your email to post picks and keep your account recoverable.
prompt.mfa: Add two-factor sign-in to protect your account.

email.title: Email
email.why: Confirming proves this address is yours. You need it to post picks to the feed and the leaderboard, and to keep your account recoverable. Early-access members also need it to claim a Founding spot.
email.sent: We sent a 6-digit code. It can take a minute.

error.code: That code isn't right or has expired.
error.rate: Too many tries. Please wait a minute.
error.generic: Couldn't send the code. Please try again.

mfa.title: Two-factor sign-in
mfa.body: After your password, Puntr asks for a 6-digit code from an authenticator app such as Google Authenticator or Authy. Once it is on, posting and profile changes need that code too.
mfa.scan: Scan this QR code with your authenticator app.
mfa.qrAlt: QR code for your authenticator app
mfa.enter: Then enter the 6-digit code it shows.

challenge.title: Enter your authenticator code
challenge.body: Open your authenticator app and enter the 6-digit code for Puntr.

error.start: Couldn't start set-up. Please try again.
error.code: That code isn't right. Check the app and try again.
error.rate: Too many tries. Please wait a minute.
error.noFactor: No authenticator app is set up on this account.
error.off: Couldn't turn it off. Sign in again with your code and retry.

password.title: Password
password.body: Set or change the password you sign in with.
password.label: New password

error.long: That password is too long. Use 72 bytes or fewer.
error.sameAsEmail: Your password can't be your email.
error.common: That password is too easy to guess. Try a longer phrase.
error.generic: Couldn't save the password. Please try again.
